title: Draft MEV protection and capture architecture spec
description: Deliverable: docs/p04/ARCHITECTURE.md covering the MEV taxonomy (sandwich, backrun, JIT-adjacent flow), the detection model over MoebiusMEVHook flow data (beforeSwap/afterSwap transient metering), the agent bidding module (searcher-style backrun capture with a proceeds-funded bidder EOA), capture routing to treasury (20 bps + residual, pull-based), and the no_treasury_key enforcement boundary (code deny-list + deploy assertion + CI grep + adversarial tests). Acceptance criteria: (1) spec ratifies the catalog gates — flow_threshold ($1,000 notional AND 50 bps impact per block) and no_treasury_key — with numeric thresholds; (2) trust-boundary diagram proves the treasury EOA is never a signer on any path; (3) worked capture example shows 1.0 ETH-equivalent → 0.002 ETH fee + 0.998 ETH residual to 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac. Numeric constraints: detection false-positive budget ≤ 5%; hot-path gas ≤ 5,000/swap. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Define hook and bidding interfaces
description: Deliverable: onchain/src/hooks/IMEVCaptureHook.sol (capture accounting: recordCapture, claimCapture; distribution claims; events CaptureRecorded, CaptureClaimed) and src/sincor2/defi/p04/interfaces.py (flow-event schema, bid-strategy interface, capture-estimate model) — frozen before core. Acceptance criteria: (1) Solidity compiles under solc 0.8.24; (2) Python is mypy-clean; (3) every downstream core module imports these interfaces (no duplicate signatures); (4) interfaces frozen — later changes require a spec amendment. Numeric constraints: event fields fixed-width for indexing; estimate model expresses amounts in wei and bps. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Specify economic and capture model
description: Deliverable: docs/p04/ECONOMICS.md — 20 bps protocol fee on captured MEV routed to 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac; capture-estimate methodology from hook flow (attributable vs noise, with the $1,000/50 bps threshold); bidder profit-share split (residual funds the bidder float; surplus beyond the 20% float cap routes to treasury); flow_threshold economics (minimum profitable capture given the 3× gas shading rule). Acceptance criteria: (1) worked sandwich-capture example with fee math to the wei; (2) break-even table showing minimum capture size vs gas price tiers (5/20/100 gwei); (3) target 9% APR on bidder float derived from modeled capture frequency. Numeric constraints: fee 20 bps; shading 3×. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Create repo layout and stub interfaces
description: Deliverable: onchain/src/hooks/p04/, src/sincor2/defi/p04/, agents/defi/p04/, tests/pytest/test_p04_*.py stubs, docs/p04/; agent YAML skeleton agents/defi/p04/mev_bidder.yaml (name, budgets, flow_threshold, gas ceiling per repo convention). Acceptance criteria: (1) tree committed; stubs compile/collect with zero errors; (2) YAML skeleton validates; (3) CI lints pass. Numeric constraints: YAML pins flow_threshold $1,000/50 bps and the treasury deny-list entry from day one. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write boilerplate starter code
description: Deliverable: MEVCaptureHook.sol boilerplate extending MoebiusMEVHook with ReentrancyGuard + SafeERC20 and non-bricking try/catch around capture accounting; Python package with flow-listener skeleton and TOA hooks; SignerRegistry stub with the treasury deny-list wired from config. Acceptance criteria: (1) forge build succeeds; (2) pytest collects with zero import errors; (3) no unresolved stub markers in public function bodies (grep-verified in CI). Numeric constraints: none yet; structure only. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement MEV capture hook skeleton
description: Deliverable: onchain/src/hooks/p04/MEVCaptureHook.sol extending MoebiusMEVHook — beforeSwap/afterSwap flow metering into EIP-1153 transient storage, per-block flow ledger keyed by (blockHash, poolId), capture accounting vault (ERC-6909 claims / ERC-20 escrow). Acceptance criteria: (1) compiles under solc 0.8.24; (2) deploys against the V4 PoolManager on a local fork (Base PoolManager 0x498581ff718922c3f8e6a244956af099b2652b2b referenced for mainnet fork); (3) flow events emitted per swap with correct before/after sqrtPriceX96. Numeric constraints: metering overhead ≤ 5,000 gas per swap; hook address mined with correct beforeSwap+afterSwap permission bits. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement MEV flow detection in afterSwap
description: Deliverable: sandwich/backrun detection in afterSwap using transient (EIP-1153) state — sandwich signature: same-block A→V→B pattern with shared sender/funding relation, victim impact > 50 bps, B reversing A; backrun signature: large displacement (> 50 bps) followed by an arbitrage-shaped reversal capturing ≥ 30% of it; flow_threshold gate ($1,000 notional AND 50 bps impact per block) filters noise. Acceptance criteria: (1) detection battery on historical fixtures — known sandwiches flagged, organic volatility not flagged; (2) precision ≥ 90%, recall ≥ 80%, false positives ≤ 5%; (3) sub-threshold flow emits no bid intent. Numeric constraints: thresholds as specified. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build proceeds-funded agent bidding module
description: Deliverable: src/sincor2/defi/p04/bidder.py — consumes FlowFlagged events, computes expected capture (estimated arb profit − gas), applies the bid-shading rule (expected_net ≥ 3× gas_cost else stand down), submits defensive backruns via a private-mempool relay from a dedicated bidder EOA funded only from captured proceeds (initial float ≤ 20% of tick capital, min $100). The module NEVER uses the treasury EOA — enforced by a code-level signer deny-list plus config assertion. Includes nonce management, exponential-backoff retries, and TOA telemetry hooks. Acceptance criteria: (1) bidder captures a scripted sandwich flow on fork with positive net PnL; (2) config test proves the treasury address is absent from the signer set; (3) sub-threshold flow produces zero bids. Numeric constraints: shading 3×; float cap 20%; estimate-vs-actual ≤ 1%. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement capture routing to treasury
description: Deliverable: capture routing — 20 bps protocol fee plus 100% residual capture to 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac via pull-based claimCapture() (non-bricking per claimant); capture estimate ledger reconciled against actual receipts with |estimate − actual| / actual ≤ 1%, breaches decaying the bidder's confidence weight. Acceptance criteria: (1) routing test — captured 1.0 ETH-equivalent yields exactly 0.002 ETH fee + 0.998 ETH residual claimable by treasury; (2) reconciliation within 1% on fork fixtures; (3) a reverting claimant does not block other claimants. Numeric constraints: fee exactly 20 bps; reconciliation tolerance 1%. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Enforce no-treasury-key invariant at every layer
description: Deliverable: code-level no_treasury_key enforcement — SignerRegistry deny-listing the treasury EOA (0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac) checked at every signing call; deployment script asserting the treasury address appears in zero signer fields; CI job grepping all configs/YAMLs for the treasury address in any key/signer field (build fails on hit); hook verified to contain no delegatecall/selfdestruct paths. Documented in docs/p04/TRUST_BOUNDARY.md. Acceptance criteria: (1) adversarial suite attempts treasury-key usage from every module (hook, bidder, deploy script, config) and all fail closed; (2) CI grep test passes; (3) TRUST_BOUNDARY.md states the guarantee precisely. Numeric constraints: zero exceptions — the deny-list has no bypass path. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement user protection rules
description: Deliverable: protective execution for opted-in orders (hookData flag) — slippage guardrail reverting fills worse than 100 bps vs the quoted price, private-mempool routing hints for protected orders, automatic revert of the fill if the hook flagged the block as toxic before the user's swap executed. Acceptance criteria: (1) protected-order fixture shows sandwich loss reduced ≥ 80% vs the unprotected baseline in fork replay; (2) guardrail revert triggers correctly at 100 bps deviation; (3) non-opted-in orders are unaffected (zero behavior change). Numeric constraints: guardrail 100 bps; loss reduction ≥ 80%. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Access control and edge-case handling
description: Deliverable: access control (BIDDER_ROLE, GUARDIAN_ROLE) plus edge-case handling — empty-capture blocks (no-ops logged), reorged flow events (idempotent accounting keyed by blockHash/poolId/txIndex — replay is a safe no-op), bidder EOA depletion below the 2× gas-reserve floor (graceful stand-down, never touches any treasury-adjacent key), gas-price spikes (bid shading tightens: expected_net ≥ 3× gas). Acceptance criteria: (1) unauthorized bid reverts; (2) reorg replay leaves ledger balances unchanged; (3) depleted bidder emits stand-down and builds zero transactions; (4) every edge case has a dedicated test. Numeric constraints: gas-reserve floor 2× gas ceiling; shading rule 3×. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write unit tests for hook and bidder
description: Deliverable: Foundry tests for flow detection and capture accounting; pytest for bidder strategy, signer deny-list enforcement, and estimate math. Acceptance criteria: (1) 24/24 pass; (2) no-treasury-key adversarial tests included; (3) each test names the invariant it guards. Numeric constraints: detection thresholds tested at boundary (49/50/51 bps); fee math exact to 1 wei. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write integration tests: attack to capture
description: Deliverable: local V4 pool + scripted sandwich attacker + hook + bidder agent — full cycle detect → bid → capture → route to treasury; tests assert treasury receipts match estimates within 1% and the 20 bps fee is exact. Acceptance criteria: (1) full cycle completes end-to-end; (2) treasury receipts equal estimate ± 1%; (3) suite green in CI; (4) no_treasury_key adversarial cases included in the integration run. Numeric constraints: fixture capture 1.0 ETH-equivalent; fee 0.002 ETH exact. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Invariant and fuzz tests
description: Deliverable: Foundry invariant suite + docs/p04/INVARIANTS.md — (a) captured accounting == distributed + fees (±1 wei); (b) treasury EOA never signs under fuzzed signer configs (all rejected); (c) honest swap value unaffected by detection (no balance drift for non-flagged swaps); (d) flow ledger idempotent under reorg replay. Acceptance criteria: (1) 10,000 runs per invariant, zero counterexamples; (2) any counterexample fixed and recorded; (3) INVARIANTS.md documents each bound. Numeric constraints: 10k runs; accounting identity to 1 wei. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Fork simulation on historical MEV flow
description: Deliverable: fork Base at a pinned block; replay blocks with known sandwich/backrun activity; measure detection precision/recall, capture rate, and bidder PnL net of gas; publish docs/p04/FORK_SIM.md. Acceptance criteria: (1) report records pinned block range, precision/recall numbers, gross capture, gas spent, and net PnL; (2) net PnL positive across the replayed window; (3) replay is re-runnable from the documented block pins. Numeric constraints: block pins documented; PnL broken down per capture. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Assemble audit-prep package
description: Deliverable: docs/p04/AUDIT.md — threat model (bidder key compromise, detection griefing, accounting drift, trust-boundary breach, reorg replay), privileged-role matrix, 100% NatSpec coverage, deployment parameters (flow_threshold, gas ceiling, treasury address), known-limitations list; code frozen with a tagged commit. Acceptance criteria: (1) package passes the repo audit checklist; (2) the trust boundary (treasury EOA never signs) is explicitly reviewed as its own checklist section; (3) every external call annotated trust/no-trust. Numeric constraints: checklist completeness binary. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Remediate audit findings
description: Deliverable: triaged findings, fixes for all High/Critical, documented accepted risks for Medium/Low, one regression test per finding, docs/p04/FINDINGS.md ledger. Acceptance criteria: (1) auditor sign-off recorded; (2) no open item above Low without written acceptance; (3) the no_treasury_key adversarial suite re-run green after every signing-path change. Numeric constraints: zero open High/Critical. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Gas optimization pass
description: Deliverable: profile swap-path metering overhead and claim functions; optimize transient-storage layout and minimize per-swap writes; docs/p04/GAS.md before/after report. Acceptance criteria: (1) ≥ 15% improvement on the swap hot path while staying within the 5,000 gas budget; (2) fuzz suite re-run green with zero behavior change; (3) claim-path gas table published. Numeric constraints: hot-path ceiling 5,000 gas/swap; improvement ≥ 15%. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write technical documentation
description: Deliverable: docs/p04/TECHNICAL.md — flow metering model, detection algorithm (both signatures with thresholds), bidding strategy (shading rule, proceeds-only funding), capture accounting, trust boundary with the no-treasury-key guarantee stated precisely. Acceptance criteria: (1) reimplementable from the doc alone; (2) all diagrams current with final code; (3) every numeric parameter from the spec table appears with its enforcing location. Numeric constraints: doc completeness. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Ship agent YAML config and ops runbook
description: Deliverable: finalized agents/defi/p04/mev_bidder.yaml (budgets, flow_threshold $1,000/50 bps, gas ceiling, key-rotation schedule) plus docs/p04/RUNBOOK.md — bidder funding from proceeds only, API/key rotation ceremony, flow_threshold tuning procedure (±50% guardian bounds), incident response for bidder-key compromise (revoke, rotate, stand-down). Acceptance criteria: (1) agent boots from the YAML with no code changes; (2) runbook rehearsed with logged timestamps, including a simulated key-compromise drill; (3) compromise drill completes rotate-and-resume within 30 minutes on testnet. Numeric constraints: thresholds match the spec table. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build dashboard and monitoring hooks
description: Deliverable: src/sincor2/defi/p04/monitor.py — detections, captures, estimate-vs-actual, treasury receipts, bidder float balance, flag rate — emitted to the SINCOR dashboard schema; alert rules for trust-boundary violations (any treasury-EOA signing attempt: critical page), bidder depletion below gas reserve, flag-rate spikes > 3× the 7-day median, and reconciliation breaches > 1%. Acceptance criteria: (1) panel renders fork-sim data; (2) trust-boundary alert tested with a simulated violation; (3) depletion alert fires before the bidder can build an underfunded transaction. Numeric constraints: thresholds as specified. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write and execute testnet deploy scripts
description: Deliverable: scripts/p04/deploy_testnet.sh + onchain/script/p04/Deploy.s.sol deploying MEVCaptureHook to Base Sepolia; Basescan verification; run scripted MEV flow (detection + simulated capture only — live bidding stays blocked) to prove the pipeline end-to-end. Acceptance criteria: (1) verified hook linked in docs/p04/DEPLOY.md with detection and capture transaction hashes; (2) treasury receipts observed for the simulated capture; (3) no_treasury_key assertions pass on the testnet deployment. Numeric constraints: live-block stays engaged on testnet. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Mainnet readiness checklist
description: Deliverable: docs/p04/MAINNET_CHECKLIST.md — audit sign-off, trust-boundary review signed as its own line item, bidder funding plan (proceeds-only, float cap 20%), multisig ownership, monitoring/alerting live, runbook rehearsed, go/no-go table. Acceptance criteria: (1) every box signed; (2) treasury EOA exclusion re-verified at deploy (deny-list + config grep + adversarial suite); (3) live-block release recorded as a separate founder-signed transaction — no mainnet bidding before it. Numeric constraints: checklist 100% signed. Per specs/p04-mev-capture.md §Acceptance criteria.
